rules.infinite_in_degree: X_1(3,15) has only finitely many points of absolute degree 8
rules.sporadic: finitely many points of each absolute degree <= 8 on X_1(3,15)
rules.isolated: finitely many points of absolute degree 8 on X_1(3,15), so the point lies in no positive-dimensional family

points.reference: F. Najman, Torsion of elliptic curves over number fields of degree 6, 7, 8 and 9 (2026), in preparation

rules.sporadic: finitely many points of absolute degree <= 10: rank 0 and 5 < 6 <= gonality of X_1(3,15) over Q(zeta_3)
rules.isolated: finitely many points of absolute degree 10 on X_1(3,15), so the point lies in no positive-dimensional family
